meta.name: init-deep
meta.description: Initializes a hierarchical AGENTS.md knowledge base for a project. Use when a repo needs its structure, commands, and conventions documented for agents.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为仓库生成分层的 AGENTS.md,让编码助手一进门就懂项目结构和约定
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果每次都要向 AI 编码助手重复交代项目结构和命令
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you keep re-explaining project structure and commands to AI coding agents

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会在你的项目里生成分层的 AGENTS.md 文件:根目录一份,再按复杂度打分挑出需要文档的子目录各一份,内容写结构、命令和约定。
howto.when: 当某个仓库需要把结构、命令和约定记录给 agent 用时触发;你也可以直接运行 /init-deep 进入,默认是更新模式(改已有、按需新建)。

say.text: 运行 /init-deep,给这个项目生成 AGENTS.md
say.note: 默认最多深入三层目录

say.text: 用 /init-deep --max-depth=2 只覆盖两层目录
用 /init-deep --create-new 读一遍现有一后全部删掉重生成
say.note: 先读取保留上下文,再从零重建

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude generates hierarchical AGENTS.md files for your project: one at the root plus one in each subdirectory that passes a complexity score, documenting structure, commands and conventions.
howto.when_en: Use when a repo needs its structure, commands and conventions documented for agents, or when you run /init-deep; the default mode updates existing files and creates new ones where warranted.

say_en.text: Run /init-deep to generate AGENTS.md for this project
say_en.note: Defaults to a max depth of three directories

say_en.text: Run /init-deep --max-depth=2 to cover only two levels
say_en.note: Limits how deep the generated files go

say_en.text: Run /init-deep --create-new to read then delete and regenerate all
say_en.note: Reads existing files first, keeps context
